name: Nate Is Late
description: Every morning, Nate and Malika leave home 30 minutes early to go to school, and yet every morning they arrive late! That’s because every morning, something AMAZING happens on the way. But even though their stories are always true, Principal Prudence never believes them…

videos.title: The Garbage Goblins
videos.overview: As Nate shows Malika the watch he got for his birthday, he drops it down a sewer grate! The kids head into the sewers to get it back, but it's been picked up by a goblin.

videos.title: The Roman Ruins
videos.overview: The way to school is blocked by a construction site. Nate and Malika decide to go through it to save time, but they end up in the ruins of an ancient Roman amphitheatre.

videos.title: The Carnivorous Plant
videos.overview: Nate has forgotten to take care of the class' carnivorous plant over the weekend. He and Malika try to restore the plant's luster but it turns it into a giant monster!

videos.title: The Dragon
videos.overview: Nate and Malika notice some burnt bushes, leading them to a baby dragon! It looks like his mother abandoned him, so Nate decides to adopt him - but raising a dragon is not easy!

videos.title: The Insects
videos.overview: Professor Toybos is putting his latest invention in the bin. It's a shrink ray, but it doesn't work... Nate plays with the controls and accidentally gets him and Malika shrunk.

videos.title: The Secret Agent
videos.overview: On the way to school, Nate and Malika bump into a strange man who claims to be an undercover secret agent.

videos.title: The Leprechaun
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet a leprechaun in the park. His name is Shaun and he's lost his pot of gold. Nate and Malika must help Shaun to find it or he will be turned to stone.

videos.title: The Adorable Monster
videos.overview: Nate and Malika are offered a free ride on a ghost train which turns out to be a cover to train young monsters.

videos.title: The Haunted House
videos.overview: Melanie gives Nate and Malika a letter to be delivered to an old mansion. The mailbox is full, so our heroes enter the house to give the letter to the resident in person.

videos.title: The Enchanted Frog
videos.overview: On the way to school, Nate and Malika meet Gideon, a young man turned into a frog by a witch. Nate tries kissing him to reverse the curse, but it transforms him too!

videos.title: The Kid From The Future
videos.overview: Nate accidentally drops his biscuit packet in the park’s lake. As he goes to get it, he hears a beautiful song coming from the waters… and falls in the lake!

videos.title: The Mermaids
videos.overview: Nate accidentally drops his biscuit packet in the park’s lake. As he goes to get it, he hears a beautiful song coming from the waters… and falls in the lake!

videos.title: The Genie
videos.overview: Melanie the mailwoman entrusts Nate and Malika with a parcel to deliver. Nate discovers it contains an oil lamp. He rubs it and a genie comes out, ready to grant Nate three wishes

videos.title: The Magic Book
videos.overview: Nate accidentally drops his biscuit packet in the park’s lake. As he goes to get it, he hears a beautiful song coming from the waters… and falls in the lake!

videos.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
videos.overview: On the way to school, Nate and Malika meet Winkle, a sixth century sorcerer's apprentice who has accidentally sent himself into the 21st century.

videos.title: The Cuddly Toy
videos.overview: Nate accidentally drops his biscuit packet in the park’s lake. As he goes to get it, he hears a beautiful song coming from the waters… and falls in the lake!

videos.title: The Superhero
videos.overview: Nate and Malika are attacked by little gooey creatures. Luckily, Miracle Girl saves them. But the attack was a trap devised by her nemesis, Gigantix, to catch her.

videos.title: The Alien
videos.overview: A spaceship lands in the park! Nate and Malika meet Zediak, an alien who is running away from space pirates. Nate and Malika want to help him, until they learn Zediak's real story.

videos.title: The Robot
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet Elvex, Professor Toybos' robot assistant. Elvex has rebelled against the professor and plans to take control of all the electrical devices in town.

videos.title: Santa's Reindeer
videos.overview: It’s almost Christmas, and Nate and Malika meet Santa Claus in the park. He lost his favourite reindeer as he was taking him for a test ride. It turns out the reindeer has been kidnapped.

videos.title: The Pocket Watch
videos.overview: Nate’s parents give him his great-grandfather’s watch to help him be on time. As he shows it to Malika, Nate activates a mysterious mechanism that traps them in a time loop.

videos.title: The Cyborgs
videos.overview: Nate and Malika discover that some of the people they see every morning are actually cyborgs with a human appearance.

videos.title: The Mummy
videos.overview: Nate and Malika sneak into a museum so they can have a private viewing of the mummy of an ancient Egyptian girl-queen.

videos.title: Grandpa
videos.overview: A small shooting star crash lands in front of Nate and Malika. She is being chased by another star who wants to absorb her light.

videos.title: The Candy Factory
videos.overview: When Nate and Malika visit a new sweet shop, Nate is so delighted by the sweets that he wants to know how the shopkeeper made them.

videos.title: The Tree People
videos.overview: Nate and Malika find Violet weeping next to an old tree that's going to be cut down. They discover there's a world inside the tree and must help save it.

videos.title: The Lucky Ring
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet a construction worker who gives Nate a magical lucky ring. As soon as he puts the ring on, Nate has incredibly good luck!

videos.title: The Faun
videos.overview: When Nate and Malika notice the faun statue in the park is missing, they follow hoof prints into a clearing where a bunch of fauns are having a giant party!

videos.title: The Ninja
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet Jin, a ninja who offers to train them. In order to become a master, he needs to prove he has students. Curious to see a real secret dojo, the kids agree.

videos.title: The Battle of the Gods
videos.overview: A storm strikes the neighbourhood and Nate and Malika discover its cause: the Greek gods Zeus and Poseidon are arguing over who deserves to rule over Mount Olympus.

videos.title: The Totems
videos.overview: Nate and Malika are surprised to come across Mrs Rainfort, Maurice and Violette all in bad moods. What could be bothering everyone?

videos.title: The Gingerbread Man
videos.overview: On the way to school, Nate and Malika save a talking Gingerbread Man from a cat. But the little biscuit boy isn't very grateful.

videos.title: The Cave Girl
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet a girl named Oona who is from the Stone Age! Oona accidentally slipped into our time period through a portal opened by Professor Toybos.

videos.title: The Flash
videos.overview: Cosmo gets rid of his old photography equipment. Nate recovers an antique camera fitted with an enormous flash!

videos.title: The Werewolf
videos.overview: A huge beast has ransacked Cosmo's kiosk. Nate and Malika investigate and find out the beast is actually a young woman who happens to be a werewolf

videos.title: The Gremlins
videos.overview: Nate and Malika come across a pair of gremlins who are planning a prank that will engulf the city in sewage. Our heroes must turn the tables on the pranksters to save the city.

videos.title: The Dinosaur
videos.overview: Professor Toybos invents a spray that turns animals into dinosaurs. Nate accidentally squirts Maurice with the dinosaur DNA, turning the boy into a T-Rex.

videos.title: The Concert
videos.overview: Malika's favourite singer is doing a charity concert in the park, but his voice is stolen. When Nate confronts him, his own voice is replaced by chicken sounds.

videos.title: The Snow Fairy
videos.overview: Nate finds a snow globe containing a fairy figurine. He accidentally breaks the snow globe and frees the fairy, who starts to turn everyone into ice statues!

videos.title: The Unicorn
videos.overview: Nate and Malika discover that a unicorn living in the park is able to control minds with his horn, so uses it on Nate and Malika to make them do his bidding.

videos.title: The Invaders (1)
videos.overview: It's the last day of school and our heroes make a point of arriving on time. Prudence can't believe it, but then she's sucked up by a tractor beam.

videos.title: The Invaders (2)
videos.overview: Earth is about to be invaded by aliens through an intergalactic portal! Can our heroes defeat them?

videos.title: The Lady of the Lake
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet a lady who was turned into water centuries ago by an ancient curse, and is trapped in the lake for eternity. To free her, they have to complete a magic ritual.

videos.title: The Thunderbird
videos.overview: Nate and Malika run into an ornithologist who's trying to prove the existence of the legendary thunderbird! She attracts one to the neighbourhood, but it's captured by Maxime Dermy.

videos.title: The Crocodile Man
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet a reporter investigating a crocodile-man hiding in the town's sewers. Things get complicated when a real crocodile appears.

videos.title: The Golem
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet Easter, an alchemist chasing the clay Golem she created. Nate and Malika have to save it from the alchemist, who wants to destroy her creature!

videos.title: The Hairdresser
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet a hairdresser with a spray that makes people's hair grow really fast. But when his own hair starts growing uncontrollably it threatens to engulf the whole town.

videos.title: The Mood Enhancer
videos.overview: Nate and Malika discover that a crazy inventor has decided to eradicate bad moods by altering everyone's brains against their will. Nate and Malika have to stop him.

videos.title: The Chess Game
videos.overview: Nate and Malika discover an old chess set in Cosmo's shop - but as Malika tries to teach Nate the rules, the pieces start to grow and restart their centuries-old fight.

videos.title: The Drone
videos.overview: Pedro, a shady businessman, is winning over the inhabitants with his super-sophisticated delivery drone, but Nate and Malika find out that he's stealing his goods from Cosmo's shop.

videos.title: The Astronaut
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet Cleo, an astronaut who has been ejected from the space station where she works with her fellow researcher Bobby. To help, our heroes embark on a space mission.

videos.title: The Gorgon
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet Stheno, a gorgon sculptor who can turn people into stone with her third eye! She turns Maurice into a sculpture for her exhibition at the museum.

videos.title: The Dimensional Rift
videos.overview: Nate and Malika go their separate ways to school. Nate comes across Professor Toybos being chased by a rival scientist, who locks him up in a dimensional rift… and Nate with him!

videos.title: The Reptilians
videos.overview: Suzaris, a reptilian who emerged from a fault line in the ground, wants to bring proof of the surface’s existence back to her home - but the rift she opened is causing earthquakes!

videos.title: The Enchanted Bracelet
videos.overview: A rain of stones is threatening to wreck Nate and Malika’s neighbourhood, because there’s a war going on in the kingdom of giants, up above the clouds!

videos.title: The Ink Thief
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet Joanna, a famous novelist who has writer’s block, so uses a magic pen to write for her! But for the pen to work, she has to feed it texts.

videos.title: The Tiki
videos.overview: The town receives a gift from Polynesia: a Tiki, a sacred volcanic stone statue. But suddenly the Tiki comes to life and threatens to unleash its devastating power on the city!

videos.title: The Puppet
videos.overview: Nate and Malika come across Garett, a ventriloquist’s magical puppet, who pranks unsuspecting people. Nate is a huge fan of Garett’s, but he and Malika soon find his pranks hurtful.

videos.title: The Mandrake
videos.overview: As Nate and Malika gather plants in the park to fill the herbarium for a school assignment, Nate mistakenly unearths a mandrake.

videos.title: The Vampires
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet Winifred, a friendly vampire. His classmate Harmony has evil intentions, and soon our heroes have to face a blood-thirsty vampire queen returning from limbo!

videos.title: The Greek Sphinx
videos.overview: In the town’s Roman ruins, Nate and Malika discover a secret passage which leads them to a Sphinx! She offers them legendary treasure if they can answer her riddles correctly.

videos.title: The Pendulum
videos.overview: Malika falls under the spell of a magic pendulum held by Marvo the hypnotist. Under his influence, she steals a precious diamond from the museum and gives it to Marvo!

videos.title: The Giant Koi
videos.overview: Nate and Malika row a boat across the lake and get swallowed by a giant fish! Inside the fish, they find Maxime Dermy, the unscrupulous animal trafficker who was swallowed too!

videos.title: The Wedding Dress
videos.overview: Nate and Malika stumble upon a magic wedding dress that’s bringing clothes to life - and the wedding dress falls in love with Nate’s new bow-tie, dragging him along!

videos.title: The Household Spirit
videos.overview: A poltergeist moves into Malika’s house and starts wrecking it! Only Malika’s 'home spirit' can get rid of it, but it was living in the bread bin that she just threw away.

videos.title: The Great Pili-Pala
videos.overview: Tako, a squid-man, wants to free the Great Pili Pala, an ancient monster. Nate and Malika must stop the Great Pili-Pala before it makes the water rise and floods the entire city!

videos.title: The Never Ending Recess
videos.overview: Nate and Malika arrive at school on time! They can enjoy the morning recess for once. But while playing hopscotch, they awake Tricksy, a strange spirit dressed like a Harlequin.

videos.title: Police Fowl
videos.overview: A robot policeman with a chicken head replaces Policeman Dwayne! Depressed, Dwayne decides to retire. But soon, the Chicken Cop malfunctions and starts wreaking havoc in the city!

videos.title: The Kitsune
videos.overview: Kitsu, a young Japanese Kitsune, is stealing food and causing mayhem in town. When the fox swallows the eye of the Jade Dragon's statue, it awakens the wrath of the dragon spirit who threatens to destroy the town!

videos.title: The Collector
videos.overview: Nils, a collector of magic game cards, turns Melanie, the town postwoman, into a character in his game! In order to free her, Nate and Malika have to challenge him.

videos.title: The Kappa
videos.overview: Nate and Malika rescue a kappa, a creature who lives in the park's pond. The creature believes it has to repay them a debt of honour, so it tries helping them - but it just makes everything worse!

videos.title: The Magic Bean
videos.overview: A rain of stones is threatening to wreck Nate and Malika's neighbourhood because there's a war going on in the kingdom of giants, up above the clouds! To stop the bombing and save their neighbourhood, our heroes must penetrate the castle and face the two-headed king of giants.

videos.title: The Demigod's Trial
videos.overview: Today is the School Olympics! Malika wants our heroes to arrive at the stadium early. They meet Chloros, a frail looking demigod who has to prove to his father, Zeus, that he is a great athlete, in order to be admitted to Mount Olympus. Nate and Malika have an idea: they will compete against Chloros, and they'll let him win. But when Zeus finds out they deceived him, he unleashes his wrath on our heroes...

videos.title: The Glitch
videos.overview: Nate and Maurice have fun playing an augmented reality video game... until they accidentally release Zimbra, an evil artificial intelligence. The evil AI turns Maurice into a computer virus that can infect people with glitches! Our heroes have to prevent Zimbra from taking over the world, while dealing with Maurice who blames them!

videos.title: The Munchkins
videos.overview: This morning, Nate finds a tiny figurine in the street, not realizing that it's an important statue belonging to the King of the Tiny Tops. Furious that his statue was stolen, the King wages war against our heroes, who don't notice anything... until Tristan, a pacifist Tiny Top, asks for their help to make peace.

videos.title: The Magicians Hat
videos.overview: This morning, Nate and Malika meet Fluffy... a talking rabbit! He needs their help, because the magical world where he lives is in danger. Our heroes are sucked into a top hat, which contains this magical world! But soon, they discover that the responsible is none other than Jack Flash, the evil magician. Our heroes must thwart the wizard's plan before it's too late.

videos.title: The Chromapix
videos.overview: Nate and Malika discover that the neighborhood is being painted grey by a Necropix, a space creature who hates colors. Luckily, Carmine, a young superheroine Chromapix, arrives to stop it! Our heroes team up with Carmine to give the town its colors back, but they soon discover that she is hiding something from them...

videos.title: The Gingerbread Family
videos.overview: On the way to school, Nate and Malika run into tiny gingerbread creatures who are causing mayhem in town. As it happens, Yvan, their gingerbread friend, has been trying to bake himself a little brother. Unfortunately, magical baking can be dangerous and soon, Nate and Malika have to save Yvan from one of his creations!

videos.title: The Alphabet Agency
videos.overview: Nate and Malika cross paths with superheroine Miracle Girl when a secret agent arrives to arrest her! He pretends that it's only for a routine check, but our heroes smell a rat. They sneak into the Alphabet Agency and find out that she's the victim of a conspiracy.

videos.title: The Wild Beasts
videos.overview: Nate and Malika run into Maurice, who is half transformed into a hamster! They take him to their friend Pat, the werewolf vet, but they find her in the middle of a quarrel with Moro, the new leader of her werewolf pack. Moro's ready to do anything to force Pat to return to the wolves!

videos.title: The Return of the Cuddly Toys
videos.overview: On their way to school, Nate and Malika run into Brian, Santa's reindeer, who needs their help - Santa's in danger! Nate and Malika climb on Brian's back and fly off to the North Pole! They discover that the local cuddly toy gang have been manipulated by Stan, Santa's evil brother!

videos.title: The Racecar
videos.overview: Spoiler alert: Nate and Malika are as late as ever! On their daily journey to school they meet old and new friends and save their neighbourhood from absolute mayhem - but Principal Prudence still won't believe a word of their stories.

videos.title: Inside Professor ToyBos
videos.overview: Spoiler alert: Nate and Malika are as late as ever! On their daily journey to school they meet old and new friends and save their neighbourhood from absolute mayhem - but Principal Prudence still won't believe a word of their stories.

videos.title: The Asteroid
videos.overview: On their way to school, Nate and Malika make a quick stop at Professor Toybos's lab, which suddenly turns into a rocket, launches into space and lands on an asteroid! But Toybos's rival, Professor Bellding, is already on the asteroid to mine its precious mineral!

videos.title: The Time-Travelers
videos.overview: Nate and Malika run into Ascor, their friend from the future, who is pursuing an odious animal trafficker who travels back in time to capture specimens of extinct species! To stop him, Nate and Malika embark on a journey through time, but they accidentally create a time paradox!

videos.title: The Nebulons
videos.overview: On their way to school, Nate and Malika run into Billy, the shepherd of the City in the Sky, who is looking for his herd of Nebulons. These funny, cloudy sheep are the main source of water in the city, so he needs to bring them back as soon as possible - but Billy is captured by Carla, a bad cowgirl!

videos.title: The Witch-Con
videos.overview: By following a mysterious black cat in the park, Nate and Malika discover a secret convention for witches! But when someone steals scrolls and potions, the witches accuse Nate and Malika. Our heroes have to try and find the real culprit to clear their names!

videos.title: The Kobolds
videos.overview: On their way to school, Nate and Malika fall into a tunnel where they meet a group of Kobolds who are digging tunnels under the city. But when their giant pet mole starts to tunnel unusually fast, the town's foundations become unstable! Helped by the Kobolds, our heroes have to stop the mole!

videos.title: The Superstars
videos.overview: The town is hosting a talent contest. Nate and Malika run into Betty, a manager who dreams of becoming rich by having her dance duo win the contest. But when one of her teen stars suddenly drops out, Betty turns to Malika to replace her.

videos.title: The Goblin Cousin
videos.overview: On their way to school, Nate and Malika set out to find the source of a terrible stench spreading across town. It turns out to be Bubo, the cousin of Pimple, their goblin friend who lives in the sewers. With Pimple's help, our heroes try to convince Bubo to take a bath!

videos.title: The Gold Crown
videos.overview: At the museum, Nate and Malika try to prevent a thief from stealing the precious golden crown of an Inca emperor, but when Nate and the thief start turning everything they touch into gold, our heroes realise the crown was cursed!

videos.title: The Scarecrow
videos.overview: There is no sunrise! Nate and Malika encounter Noctis, small black creatures that gather in cities and plunge them into darkness. Fortunately, Jack the Scarecrow is here to chase them away!

videos.title: The Banana Peel (1)
videos.overview: Nate and Malika are trying to be on time for the last day of school, but Nate slips on a banana peel. That's nothing unusual, but the banana peel turns out to be alive and requests help getting its human form back.

videos.title: The Banana Peel (2)
videos.overview: Nate and Malika help Ben, the banana peel, get his powers back, but he betrays them. Instead of using his powers to become human, he takes revenge on humanity by turning the town into a magic realm! As magical creatures invade the city, our heroes try to help.

videos.title: The Reality Show
videos.overview: Nate and Malika have been kidnapped by aliens fascinated by their morning adventures. Quotax, the producer of Galactic TV, is so impressed that he wants to make a show with them as the stars! Nate isn't interested at all and just wants to escape, but Malika, still upset about losing the class elections the day before, wants to stay in this place where everyone seems to adore her...

videos.title: The Books
videos.overview: It's chaos at the library this morning: all the characters have escaped from their books and have come to life in the real world... including Johnny Cross and Leviah, Nate and Malika's favorite heroes! Unfortunately, the two are arguing and refuse to work together. And when their arch-enemies, Dr. Spectre and Arié, also emerge from the books, things start to get even more complicated...

videos.title: The Blue Rose
videos.overview: Fahim, the former genie of the lamp, is feeling down. He wants to give his beloved Mrs. Rainfort a blue rose, just like in her favorite Arabian Nights tale! Following Nate’s idea, the genie takes them into the magical world of the story. Together, they have to complete several challenges to find the blue rose... but it seems like these challenges have another purpose...

videos.title: The Friendship Bracelet
videos.overview: Malika made a friendship braid for Nate! They tie the braid and make a wish that will come true when the bracelet breaks. Nate vows to always do everything with Malika, and, out of impatience, breaks his bracelet himself... But the vow doesn't really have the desired effect!

videos.title: The Valkyrie
videos.overview: Two Valkyries take Suzie by force to Asgard so that she can fulfill her destiny: to be a Valkyrie, like her ancestor before her! Nate and Malika follow her to help her make a choice: follow the destiny that the gods are imposing on her or find her own path?

videos.title: Work Terry
videos.overview: Malika plays a simulation game all night where you can recreate your entire life... but the changes made in the game also seem to materialize in real life! Terry, furious at having been caught being scolded by his father, takes the game for a spin ...

videos.title: Cosmo's Bazar
videos.overview: Nate and Malika help Cosmo look for a broach he holds dear and which he lost. They discover that the basement of Cosmo's kiosk is a gigantic Ali Baba cave where he has stored objects accumulated throughout his thousand and one lives... and where a junk monster is chases them!

videos.title: The Daruma
videos.overview: Nate and Malika help Kikujiro, a Daruma, to grant the wish of the human who drew his first eye so that he gets the second... They ask Toybos for help before realizing that this is all a Machiavellian plan of Toybos' rival, Professor Belding...

videos.title: The Season Fairies
videos.overview: The Winter Fairy's sisters have decided that no one likes her season and are refusing to let her cool down the neighborhood. Instead, Summer Spring and Autumn each take over a corner of the city to give free rein to their season...

videos.title: The Snowman
videos.overview: This morning is the witches' Christmas market! Nate and Malika meet a Snowman as kind as he is naive, named Turnip, who is looking for the person who gave him life... Our heroes figure out that it is none other than Jack Flash, the evil magician, who wants to take revenge on the witches!

videos.title: The Little Giant
videos.overview: Emilie, a classmate of Nate and Malika, is very self-conscious about her tall size. Even if they don't see the problem, Nate and Malika decide to help their friend. They use a shrink ray from Professor Toybos, but nothing goes as planned...

videos.title: The Crystal Ball
videos.overview: Since Michael Martin inherited a crystal ball from his grandfather that's supposed to predict future crimes, his over zealousness could lead him to put the entire town in prison... Unless Officer Mélissa, aided by our heroes Nate and Malika, manage to stop him!

videos.title: The Case of the Sound Thief
videos.overview: A mysterious thief has stolen the Tuning Fork of Silence from Adèle, the witch, and extinguishes the sound of the entire city. A case worthy of the super detectives Nate and Malika! Our heroes carefully investigate in an attempt to unmask the culprit...

videos.title: The Beach Class
videos.overview: Today Nate and Malika are in Beach Class! Malika reads the diary of her pirate ancestor, Maïssa, which tells of her quest for a mysterious treasure... in the precise place where they are! The children decide to follow the trail, pursued by another classmate, Phil...

videos.title: The Pied Piper
videos.overview: Soizic, a renowned teacher of druidic music, asks Nate and Malika for help. She needs to find Ronan, a student on the run, who has a very dangerous magical instrument! When our heroes find Ronan, they realize that Solveig had lied to them.

videos.title: The Sandman
videos.overview: No one seems to have slept a wink last night in town... Nate and Malika, exhausted, find the Sandman sleeping on his cloud, he can no longer work because of his sleep debt.

videos.title: Miracle Girl Blues
videos.overview: Since the super heroine Miracle Girl defeated the villain Gigantix, she no longer really knows what her place in the world is. Nate and Malika try to help her find a new pass time. But after a lifetime of fighting the same enemy, Miracle Girl thinks she sees Gigantix everywhere!

videos.title: The Monkey King
videos.overview: Nate, fascinated by the intrepid side of the Monkey King whom they have just freed, wants to become his disciple. The Monkey King accepts! Nate is over the moon, but he soon regrets it: beneath his show-off appearance, and despite his powers and his tricks, the Monkey King is perhaps not as strong as the Horned God.

videos.title: The Singer
videos.overview: Marco Vega asks Nate and Malika to help him find Mysteria, a brilliant but anonymous artist with whom he wants to sing a duet! Malika recognizes the voice: it is that of Hydra, the queen of the mermaids. Our heroes travel to her underwater kingdom...

videos.title: The Fun House
videos.overview: Wizimix, the friendly monster, has opened a Fun House in the city's funfair! Nate and Malika really want to check it out before school, but Maurice not so much... however, Maurice is afraid of everything!

videos.title: The Old Movie
videos.overview: Brütz, the evil manager of the circus, has bought the town's movie theater and no longer wants to show old films there, which he finds rubbish. After an old projector malfunctions, Nate, Malika, and Max the projectionist, are projected into an old film...

videos.title: The Soccer Match
videos.overview: The Valkyries and Freya have returned to Earth to announce Ragnarok (the end of the world). Suzie, the children's soccer coach, suggests playing the fate of the world on the pitch!  Nate and Malika are stunned, they have no chance of winning!

videos.title: Intergalactic Influencer
videos.overview: Kim, an intergalactic influencer, arrives on Earth to shoot a travel video for her fans. But horror! Earth isn't at all what she thought! Nate and Malika show her the best neighborhoods in their city, but Kim decides to use filters that alter more than just her videos ...

videos.title: The Signs of the Zodiac
videos.overview: According to their horoscopes, Nate and Malika are supposed to hate each other, no matter what! The signs of Libra (Malika) and Aries (Nate) materialize on Earth and take children into the Zodiac. There, they subject them to tests intended to separate them...

videos.title: The War of the Chefs
videos.overview: This morning, Nate and Malika are arguing: which of Nate's dad's Coco pancakes or Malika's mom's Gazelle horns are the best tasting dessert? They meet with Josette and Ladouceur, the town's two pastry chefs, who are about to give a cooking demonstration.

videos.title: The Necropix
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet the Chromapix UltraViolet and Carmine. They are in the process of recoloring, to remove all traces of white, black and gray, the colors of their enemies, the Necropix!

videos.title: The Store
videos.overview: This morning, Nate and Malika notice the adults in town are acting a little strange... In the street, the inhabitants, as if zombified, go to an "ecological" store that Nate and Malika have never seen before. They realize that it's another stunt orchestrated by Pedro, the evil entrepreneur!

videos.title: Galatea
videos.overview: Nate and Malika meet Galatea, a statue, who wishes to go to the exhibition of Stheno, the gorgon-sculptor. Unfortunately, Higgins, who inadvertently brought her to life, wants to turn her back into stone to finish making her into the most perfect statue of Aphrodite!

videos.title: The Role-Playing Game (1)
videos.overview: Robin, a former playmate, deplores that Prudence has put aside her taste for role-playing to concentrate on her responsibilities and her job. With the help of a magic die, he takes Nate, Malika, and Prudence to the world of the Kingdom of Light, their favorite game back in the day...

videos.title: The Role-Playing Game (2)
videos.overview: The sequel to Role Playing Game - part 1, where we discovered Robin's true light! Nate and Malika return to the game, this time accompanied by Emilie and Maurice. They will have to learn to listen to each other in order to write their own story...

videos.title: The Small People
videos.overview: The tree people have captured Tristan, the Lilliputian, accusing him of having kidnapped their princess Flora. Nate and Malika, insect-sized, lead the investigation and find Flora who admits to them that she and Tristan are in fact... in love!

videos.title: The Pack
videos.overview: Nate and Malika accidentally find themselves morphed into a dog and a cat respectively... They meet Ajax, Mrs. Raifort's dog who claims to have been abandoned. With Spud, the friendly but imposing bulldog, they form a small pack whose sole motto is: freedom!

videos.title: The Stage Coach
videos.overview: Malika is very stressed about the presentation she has to give in front of class this morning, the subject of which is very close to her heart! Nate suggests that they ask for help from someone who knows the stage and stage fright. Why not Garett, the ventriloquist puppet?

videos.title: Pandora
videos.overview: Everyone is strangely polite and affable this morning, it's as if... no one has any flaws anymore! This is the mission Zeus gave Pandora, who is removing everyone's flaws with her infamous box.

videos.title: The Cowboy
videos.overview: At the fair, Nate wins a pair of cowboy boots. When he puts them on, he discovers they're possessed by a cowboy named John "Littlefoot" Sullivan. Together they decide to help Sullivan check off his bucket list before he returns to his family.

videos.title: The Fountain of Youth
videos.overview: Nate and Malika follow Adele the Witch to the Fountain of Youth! Nate, who would like to become a little younger so that he can be taken care of like when he was a baby, dips HIS finger in... but Malika, who tries to stop him, falls completely in !

videos.title: The Little Brother
videos.overview: Malika has to take her little brother Bilel to the babysitter this morning... but nothing goes as planned! Bilel, who finds a magic scepter, floats up into the air... Our heroes set off in pursuit on a witch's broom, for an adventure that will lead them to the City in the Sky.

videos.title: The Trial of the Sphinx
videos.overview: The Sphinx, who only speaks in riddles, asks Nate and Malika for help. They understand as best they can that she is so afraid of failing her trial to join the Other World that she didn't show up the first time and has punished for it!

videos.title: The Bonnet
videos.overview: Following an argument with her mother, Malika's wool bonnet turns into a wool-eating creature! Thanks to the help of Nate's grandpa and his expert knitting friends, our heroes try to overcome the monster... But things take a turn for the worst when Malika's mother gets involved!

videos.title: Maurice's Big Day
videos.overview: Today is Maurice's Big Day! He is the leading role in the play he is performing in this morning at school. But on the way to school, he meets Nate and Malika, in the middle of one of their adventures... and they need his help!

videos.title: Triboulet's Game
videos.overview: Nate is super impatient: this morning, it's the Middle Ages Fair at school! But when they arrive: there is nothing, no decoration, no plays, not even Prudence! Instead, they find Triboulet, the recess genie. Today, he's the one organizing the fair!

videos.title: The Blooming City
videos.overview: Nate and Malika discover that Violette, the gardener, is totally out of control! Caught up in the Flowery City competition, she transforms anyone who gets in her way into a plant! The children will find themselves playing out the fate of the city... with darts!

videos.title: The Dermyosotis
videos.overview: Nate and Malika discover, astounded, the park in a state of total drought: an enormous flower is draining all the water! They discover to their great surprise that Maxime Dermy, the former animal trafficker, has converted to gardening...

videos.title: The Stormkeeper
videos.overview: Faced with the threat of a violent storm caused by the Casper Nebula, Nate and Malika leave on an aerial mission after Joséphine's alert.

videos.title: The Vampire School
videos.overview: Nate and Malika go to... Vampire school! Carolina, the vampire mistress, accompanied by Winfred, their old vampire friend, awaits them there. But Winfred is his usual self: he must follow a course to be a "real" vampire and no longer feel emotions. Nate and Malika will make him understand that emotions are not a weakness, but a strength!

videos.title: The Nommos
videos.overview: On their way to school, the children take a break at the Museum... the only place where it's cool in town today! They discover an exhibition on the Nommos, water genies! Our heroes call the Nommos who arrive in a ship and end the drought. This is a problem easily resolved this morning! Well, maybe not: because when they left, the Nommos forgot one of their own... and the town Mayor won't let him go!

videos.title: The Election
videos.overview: Nate and Malika try to find a home for Snort and Drool, former Hitting Spirits who also want to become Home Spirits. But it seems that Bonz, their former friend, has led a real campaign against them among the townspeople!

videos.title: The Half-Nymph Trial
videos.overview: Zeus has organized a big party in the park, and everyone is impatiently awaiting the singing performance of Chloros, the half-Nymph... But he is in a total panic: he doesn't know what to sing, or how! By acting as Chloros' singing coach, our heroes will realize that their friend's problem is in fact much deeper...

videos.title: The Scientists
videos.overview: Toybos, the scientist, has disappeared! He's stuck in a video game, and the evil A.I. ZIMBRA seems to be involved. To save him, Nate and Malika will have to team up with Belding, Toybos' sworn enemy. But can they even really trust him?

videos.title: The Scepter of the Giants
videos.overview: Nate left his notebook on the table when he left for school, and his mother Alice discovered all the accumulated Tardy Notes in it! Following her son's trail, she finds him in the Kingdom of Giants, on a mission to crown a new king... A mission that fails because of her. Fortunately, by finding the scepter of the Giants, everything might go back to normal...

videos.title: Nate Without Malika (1)
videos.overview: Today is the last day of school before summer vacation. Malika sadly admits that at the start of the next school year, they will no longer be in the same school, because she is moving... Nate is furious: how could she hide that from him?! She promised they would always be friends!

videos.title: Nate Without Malika (2)
videos.overview: Stuck in a chaotic reality where they have not experienced any of their morning adventures and where, above all, they have never been friends, will Nate and Malika manage to overcome their bickering to save the world...?
